title: Opaque Space distribution: no Space-ID gossip topics
description: Required by Q6(b). v1/agora/space/<spaceCID> and v1/agora/mls/<groupID> topics expose Space/group identity to relays (09 §4.1, 02, 03 §9.5 moderation broadcast, 07 §18.3). Decision (Mark 2026-10-16): distribute Space state by CID from a CO-hosted endpoint; no relay topic. Remove/replace these topics across parts.
